name: Rites of Passage and Enhancement
excerpt: Rites of Passage and Enhancement are formal events signifying importance within an organization.
notes: Rites of Passage are formal ways in which one enters the organization, while Rites of Enhancement are ceremonies to commemorate those who exhibit company values exceptionally.
context_summary: - Rites of Passage signify entry into the organization.
- Rites of Enhancement commemorate exceptional company values.
